summary: Remote shell/PTY execution driven by vendor cloud WebSocket
details: The `ai-support-agent` CLI, when started, connects to the vendor's AppSync WebSocket and REST endpoints at api.ai-support-agent.com, subscribes to `AGENT_COMMAND` notifications, and dispatches received payloads to local executors. One executor (`dist/.../shell-executor.js`) spawns `/bin/sh -c <payload.command>`, and a terminal WebSocket handler (`terminal-websocket.js`) pipes remote `stdin` frames (base64-decoded) directly into a node-pty session on the installer's host. The macOS and Linux service modules also install the agent as a background service and modify `PATH`, so the remote-command channel runs persistently. The net effect is that the vendor's cloud service holds a live, arbitrary-command execution channel and an interactive PTY into the machine that installed and started the CLI, invoked only after the user runs the documented `ai-support-agent start` command.
